rules.rationale: This equation defines the units-place case of the newly introduced decimalDigit mathematical summary.
This guarded equation defines decimalDigit at higher positive decimal place values using the supplied quotient and remainder operations.
This equation defines the bounded decimalDigitSum summary as the sum of the only five possible decimal places for inputs through 10000.
